name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
summary: A cable pulldown with a wide overhand grip that trains the lats and upper back. A scalable alternative to pull-ups.
setup: Adjust the thigh pad so your legs are snug and you cannot lift off the seat.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip just outside shoulder width.
Sit tall, lean back slightly, and let the arms extend with the shoulders set down.
execution: Pull the shoulder blades down first.
Drive the elbows down and slightly back, bringing the bar to the upper chest.
Let the bar rise under control until the arms are straight.
cues: Chest up to meet the bar
mistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck: bring it to the upper chest in front.
Leaning far back and swinging: reduce the weight and keep a slight, fixed lean.
Letting the weight pull the shoulders up at the top: control the return and keep the lats engaged.
Grip too wide to feel the lats: use just outside shoulder width.
